## Hypothesis

The REQUIRE_BEARISH_FILL_BAR block (gates.py #7) was ratified under an old bracket-only OTM engine but no longer provides edge under the current real-fills + managed-exit engine. It suppresses a net-winner set of bear trades (+$917 IS) and fails key walk-forward and consistency gates. Removing the block (setting require_bearish_fill_bar=false for Bold) is expected to improve edge capture by allowing these trades to run.

## Mechanism

The gate fires on BEAR/P entries when a look-ahead fill bar is bearish (close < open). Under the current engine (real fills, ITM-2, −7% premium stop, chandelier profit-lock arm+5%/trail15%), the gate removes 33 bear trades that net +$917 IS (13 winners +$2,759, 20 losers −$1,841). The block's original rationale (avoiding weak bearish fills) is inverted by managed exits, which let winners run and cap losers, turning the gate into a net suppressor of winners.
